Changes since [1.4.1](https://github.com/ops-software/mini-oled-dock/releases/tag/v1.4.1): the self-updater can download its first update.

### Fixes

- **Update now works on a fresh install.** The updater keeps downloads in `%ProgramData%\mini-oled-dock\update`, a folder it creates on the first download. Before downloading, it checks whether the release is already there; when the folder did not exist yet, that check reported a failed verification instead of "not downloaded", so the download never started. **Settings → Updates** showed "Download failed verification" and `dock.log` showed `cannot read the staged files: cannot open ...\update`. A missing folder now means "not downloaded yet" and the download starts.

### Install / update

Requires Windows 11. **On 1.4.0 or 1.4.1, install this release by hand once:** their updater has the bug above and cannot fetch it. Download `dock.exe` and run it from a terminal:

```powershell
.\dock.exe --install
```

It asks for administrator rights, replaces the installed dock and restarts it. Settings are kept. From 1.4.2 on, **Settings → Updates → Update now** installs the next releases by itself.
